g.text: Hotel Finder · Part 2 chatbot — early mockup
Explore hotels: existing ZIP search + synchronized list/map
Preserve Add to Local, Remove from Local and local-first lookup.
Simulated course rates and availability. Saved subset only. No reservations.
Assistant: matching hotels, complete stay totals,
nightly evidence and reasons supported by records.
▸ View retrieval: proposed SQL → records → answer
Ask a question with a ZIP and dates…
States: loading (“Checking saved stays…”), grounded answer, no matches, retryable error.
Keyboard: labeled input + native buttons/disclosures; trace and conversations survive refresh.
Small screens: conversation picker above messages. Evidence uses readable wrapping and scrolling.
